name: Abavornis
isnote: Probably an enantiornithine (Wikipedia revision cited); PBDB places it in Alexornithidae, a family not used here.
sum: Turonian bird from the Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan known from fragments, probably an enantiornithine.
holotype: A fragmentary bone from the Bissekty Formation (number in Panteleyev 1998).
material: The holotype and possibly referred fragments.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Panteleyev 1998

sources.text: Panteleyev, Andrey V. 1998. New species of enantiornithines (Aves: Enantiornithes) from the Upper Cretaceous of Central Kyzylkum. Russkii Ornitologicheskii Zhurnal 35(Express): 3–15.
